notes: Independent manual audit of all 16 eligible production TypeScript files and the full manifest; all 33 plugin files are explicitly reviewed or excluded. Verified every plugin file byte-for-byte against pinned commit d912f0c06e7af29a4a40c4211bec0bb76d473f10. No Inspector implementation, helpers, detector output, other fixture, or extraction tool was read or used.

No package.json exists under extensions/active-memory. Root package metadata publishes dist/ and provides the exact 20 consumed SDK subpath exports. This fixture is source-phase only; no claim is made that erased type references or every source file appears in a published artifact.

All production relative imports remain inside extensions/active-memory; there is no additional plugin-owned/shared shipped source boundary. Public SDK facades were checked for exported symbol identity and API/runtime type contracts only; their implementation dependencies and installed dependencies are not recursively attributed to this plugin.

The manifest declares doctorContract.configRepair, startup activation, categories, config/UI metadata, but no channels/providers/skills/commandAliases/cliCommands/contracts entries covered by the agreed manifest identity rules. Consequently it contributes no manifest-contract findings.
All three index.*.test-support.ts helpers have only index.test.ts callers. Functions named ForTests inside otherwise production modules remain in the reviewed source scope.

api aliases inside typed helper parameter objects normalize to api; api.runtime members normalize to runtime. api.config.session.mainKey is independently observed alongside bare api.config; prefixes of longer member paths are not invented.

OpenClawPluginApi["runtime"]["agent"]["runEmbeddedAgent"] supplies type references in recall.ts and recall-run.ts. Its runtime invocation makes that member mixed. readSessionTranscriptRawDelta is also mixed because transcript.ts uses a direct typeof type query, while its module receives runtime classification only at that file import site.

ActiveMemoryTranscriptSource is a direct type alias of SessionTranscriptTargetParams. Local type-import sites and downstream annotations retain that SDK-export provenance. Exported type declarations are not reexport specifiers. Projected ConversationRecallContext, MemoryAudience, ActiveRecallParams and other plugin-owned composites do not re-enumerate inferred SDK members.

Callback ctx/event/toolAuthority objects, config objects, provider/manager/capability values returned by SDK free functions, and keyed stores returned by runtime.state.openKeyedStore are not API/runtime handles. Their members do not become additional API/runtime or SDK-export reference kinds. SDK helper internals and plugin-owned forwarding wrapper invocations are not inferred.

SDK function call sites retain call kinds, explicit imported types retain type-reference kinds, and ordinary imports retain runtime dependency classification even for bare value use such as DEFAULT_PROVIDER. Finding evidence is representative per file/kind; findingCount counts distinct identities occurring in each reviewed file.
